text: ながい　しっぽが　たなびいて　とんでいく　すがたは　すばらしい。

structure.jp: ながい　しっぽが　たなびいて
structure.en: with its long tail streaming behind

structure.jp: とんでいく　すがたは
structure.en: the sight of it flying off

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after the て-form of a verb says the action moves away from where you are. とんでいく = 'flies off'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: とんでいく　すがた
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. とんでいく　すがた = 'the sight of it flying off'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here it tells you what is going on while the next thing happens. しっぽが　たなびいて　とんでいく = 'flies off with its tail streaming'.
